fieldValues.title: A person working with AI in Group meaning ownership
fieldValues.summary: Someone in a group who directs AI within the group's shared records. Without the group's own tools, the AI's output becomes the group's meaning by default; they need the group to stay the author of what it means.
goals: Keep the group the author of its meaning, with AI as a helper
Work in the group's own view, with its purpose in sight
jobs: Direct an agent on the group's records
Tell an agent's proposal from what the group decided
Open a group's repository with an agent
fieldValues.needs: Tools the group owns that keep its meaning in its hands: AI proposes, the group decides, and the record shows which is which.
